title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18
lineage: Master cassette -> metal cassette x 2 -> CD-R (Sony K717ES -> Marantz CDR500) -> Audacity -> FLAC; Pitch adjusted - 1% to match patch source.
source: FOB audience recording, taper and equipment unknown - may have been Dan Healy

ai_review.summary: Clear front‑of‑house audience tape captures a high‑energy Ventura show highlighted by a thunderous “Loser” performance.
ai_review.review: The recording offers surprisingly crisp FOB sound with good presence and clear bass, aside from a brief cut in “Ramble On Rose” that has been patched in later versions. Musically the show is praised as tight and powerful, with many fans citing the “Loser” – especially Jerry’s soaring solo and Phil’s booming bass – as a standout moment.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars, praising both performance and sound; minor technical glitches are noted but do not detract from overall enjoyment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house capture with clear presence and solid bass; a noticeable cut at 5:35 in “Ramble On Rose” (fixed in later version); overall clarity praised.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Tight, well‑structured performance that maintains high energy throughout; fans describe it as a “tight show” with strong momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His solo on “Loser” is described as thundering, haunting and one of the highlights of the night.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass work on “Loser” earns praise for powerful ‘bass bombs.’
